item.title: 2 injured during Pinellas Park domestic stabbing incident: Police
item.description: Two people were injured on Monday afternoon during a domestic incident involving a knife, according to the Pinellas Park Police Department. Few details have been released, but police said the injuries are not believed to be life-threatening.Police said one person has been detained.Details of what led up to the stabbing have not been released.The investigation is still active.
